editorial:
Imagine you are totally broke and desperate for a paycheck, only to get hired for the easiest job ever: driving a rich kid to rehab. That is exactly where you start with these two losers who think they have finally hit the jackpot. But as soon as they get their passenger in the car, everything goes south. The kid is a complete nightmare who turns the trip into a wild ride full of drugs and bad decisions. It feels like one of those movies where everything that can go wrong does go wrong, and you just have to sit back and enjoy the mess.

The acting is great because the chemistry between the two drivers makes the jokes land perfectly. The movie moves fast, and the twists keep you guessing about who is actually in charge. While some of the crime parts get a bit over the top, it just adds to the fun. You should definitely watch this if you love stories about people getting in over their heads. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video or renting it on Apple TV to see all the chaotic action clearly.
endingExplained: In the end, the drivers realize the teen was playing them the whole time to avoid rehab and steal money. After a huge car chase and a messy fight with some criminals, the drivers manage to trick the kid and keep a large stash of cash for themselves. They never actually make it to the clinic, and the movie ends with them driving away rich, though they are still just as clueless as they were at the start.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves chaotic road trip movies and dark humor.
